digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud/DC adapter — user identity model
propositions: Cloud identifies users by opaque accountId; Data Center identifies them by name, requiring two distinct identity resolution implementations with a shared contract
PR #120's DC implementation used unreachable getattr-discovered _assignee_resolver, returning authoritative=False for all assignees and causing assignee-diff churn
NameIdentity must perform real lookup against DC's user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True and converge diffs, not echo local values
The UserIdentityModel protocol must define resolve(local_value, remote_identity) returning (value, authoritative, is_account_id) and to_payload(value) for deployment-specific assignee field shape

A parameterized contract test covering all three resolution states (empty, same, different identity) must pass for both AccountIdIdentity and NameIdentity, with DC explicitly returning authoritative=True for resolvable assignees
